events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona
events.desc: Did you enjoy the tapas crawl on Wednesdays? Wednesdays still taste better than ever at Time Out Market Barcelona. Take note: if you collect at least 4 stamps on your "tapa passport", we’ll treat you to a free beer at the main bar.

events.title: Views and Show by Aperol Spritz
events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona

events.title: Salsa Time
events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona
events.desc: Do you love dancing salsa? Come to Time Out Market! Every Saturday, from 7 PM to 10 PM, we host a massive dance floor for you to move with other Latin music fans. Tickets are 10 euros and include a drink (water, beer, soft drink, or a glass of wine). And take note: we’re taking advantage of the good weather to hold the party on one of the coolest terraces in the Market (and in Barcelona): the Mestral.
